result:
The build passes and the Home screen renders correctly with both buttons (screenshot confirms). Full tap-driven UI automation of the Transcribe flow isn't possible right now — `osascript`/System Events needs Accessibility permission for the terminal app, which isn't granted in this environment, and I won't change system privacy/security settings without your OK.

Summary of what's done:
- Implemented Section 5 (Transcribe/Speech) in `app/components/Transcribe.vue`: authorization status via `SFSpeechRecognizer.authorizationStatus()`/`requestAuthorization`, transcription via `SFSpeechURLRecognitionRequest` with `shouldReportPartialResults = true`, live partial updates, and a `Completed in N.N s` line timed from tap to final result.
- Bundled `spec-assets/sample.wav` by copying it (spec-assets itself untouched) into `app/assets/sample.wav`, loaded at runtime via `knownFolders.currentApp().path` — verified it lands at `nsbenchmark.app/app/assets/sample.wav` in the built bundle.
- Added `NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription` to `Info.plist` (required or the authorization request would crash).
- `ns build ios` succeeds; installed and launched on the simulator — Home screen confirmed working via screenshot.

Not verified: actually tapping through Request Access → Transcribe Sample and watching live partial results/final transcript/timing, since that needs Accessibility-based UI automation I can't enable here. If you want, I can walk you through granting Terminal Accessibility access so I can drive the taps, or you can test that flow manually in the Simulator.
